## Overview

This directory contains application-level testing patterns that address cross-cutting test architecture concerns — particularly those arising from polyglot delivery models where the same behavioral specification must be verified across multiple language implementations.
page_texts.3:
[patterns/application/testing/README.md#purpose]

## Purpose

Establish testing patterns that:

- Define how language-neutral test specifications (Gherkin `.feature` files) are managed, synchronized, and executed across polyglot codebases
- Ensure behavioral consistency across all supported language implementations through shared specification artifacts
- Integrate with CI/CD pipelines to enforce cross-language test passage as a merge gate
